race.comment: SAMARELLE (8) flashed home fresh under the big weight behind a smart one at Warwick Farm, then relished the mile second-up when scoring with a bit up her sleeve. The rise to 1800m looks perfect for her now and she's the one to beat. BARBRAY (3) is the clear danger after missing by a lip at Toowoomba, having also been held up when favourite two back. Has been low-flying since joining the QLD satellite stable and finds another nice race. MIRRA IMPACT (5) was sound behind BARBRAY at Toowoomba and gets a small swing over him at the weights. The trip remains a query. BECAMO (4) is shooting for the hat-trick and deserves obvious respect.
